Settings.title: Setting
Settings.readOnlyNote: Only an Admin can change these values.
Settings.adminNote: Material types and outlets can be added, renamed, reordered and deleted. Style, temp and strength keep their values; only their names and order change.

strength.label: Strength
strength.rule: Fixed values 0 to 10; meanings do not change.
strength.adminRule: Fixed at 0 to 10. You can name each level and change the order.

beverageStyle.label: Beverage Style
beverageStyle.rule: Values in use can only be deactivated.
beverageStyle.adminRule: The styles are fixed. You can rename them in both languages and change the order.

unit.label: Unit
unit.rule: g and ml only; not free text.

temp.label: Temp
temp.adminRule: The options are fixed. You can rename them in both languages and change the order.

materialType.label: Material Type
materialType.rule: Values in use can only be deactivated.
materialType.adminRule: Add, rename, reorder or delete. A type already used by a material is disabled instead of deleted.

outlet.label: Outlet
outlet.adminRule: Add, rename, reorder or delete. An outlet already in use is disabled instead of deleted.

currency.label: Currency
currency.rule: Only MYR at launch. More currencies may be added later; there is no currency conversion.

language.label: Language
language.rule: English and Simplified Chinese enabled. Malay later.

import.intro: Add many items at once. Every row is checked first; nothing is saved until all rows are correct.
import.materialsHint: Use the template. Required columns: name, type, pack_size and unit (g or ml). Write yes in no_brand for products without a brand. Leave the price blank if unknown.

Reports.title: Reports
Reports.note: Choose a report. Managers see their own outlets; Admins see all outlets.
Reports.noAccess: Reports are available to Managers and Admins only.

cost.summary: Cost, selling price, gross margin and cost rate of approved drinks.
